import bids_io = "./bids_io.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

class Candidate(int number, nat32 bundle, int value)
class Clock(int winner, int price, int steps, int[] drops)

Candidate[] enumerate_candidates(bids_io.Bid[] bids, bool xor_bid)
    Candidate[] result := []
    stop := 2 ^ int(#bids)
    for: 1 <= number < stop
        selected := nat32(number)
        if xor_bid and report.mask_size(selected) != 1
            continue
        nat32 bundle := 0
        value := 0
        disjoint := true
        for: i < int(#bids)
            if report.contains_item(selected, i)
                if (bundle AND bids[i].bundle) != 0
                    disjoint = false
                    break
                bundle = bundle OR bids[i].bundle
                value += bids[i].amount
        if disjoint
            result = result.append(Candidate(number, bundle, value))
    return result

int value_of(Candidate[] candidates, nat32 items)
    result := 0
    for candidate := candidates[]
        if (candidate.bundle AND items) == candidate.bundle and candidate.value > result
            result = candidate.value
    return result

Clock english_clock(bids_io.Participant[] participants, int reserve, int increment)
    price := reserve
    steps := 0
    int[] remaining := []
    for: i < int(#participants)
        if participants[i].value >= price
            remaining = remaining.append(i)
    winner := -1
    paid := 0
    while #remaining >= 2
        previous := remaining
        price += increment
        steps += 1
        remaining = []
        for: i < int(#participants)
            if participants[i].value >= price
                remaining = remaining.append(i)
        if #remaining == 0
            winner = previous[0]
            paid = price - increment
            break
    if #remaining == 1
        winner = remaining[0]
        paid = price
    int[] drops := []
    for participant := participants[]
        drop := if participant.value < reserve then reserve else reserve + ((participant.value - reserve) / increment + 1) * increment
        drops = drops.append(if drop <= price then drop else -1)
    return Clock(winner, paid, steps, drops)

Clock dutch_clock(bids_io.Participant[] participants, int reserve, int start, int decrement)
    price := start
    steps := 0
    while price >= reserve
        winner := -1
        for: i < int(#participants)
            if participants[i].bid >= price and (winner < 0 or participants[i].bid > participants[winner].bid)
                winner = i
        if winner >= 0
            return Clock(winner, price, steps, [])
        price -= decrement
        steps += 1
    return Clock(-1, 0, steps, [])

class Item(string name, int reserve)
class BidderLine(string name, string language, string[] bids)
class AuctionInput(string name, string[] offered)
    BidderLine[] lines := []
class Participant(string name, int value, int bid)
class Group(string kind, string name, string[] arguments)
    Participant[] participants := []
class Parameters(string[] runs, int max_bundle_size, int max_bids, int core_max, int saa_increment, int round_cap, int seed, int english_increment, int dutch_start, int dutch_decrement)
class Bid(int number, int bidder, nat32 bundle, int amount, bool xor_bid, int size, int reserve)
class Inputs(Item[] items, AuctionInput[] auctions, Group[] groups, Parameters parameters)

string[] input_lines(string filename)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + filename))
    rows := text.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

Inputs read_inputs()
    Item[] items := []
    for row := input_lines("items.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        items = items.append(Item(fields[0], int(fields[1])))
    AuctionInput[] auctions := []
    for row := input_lines("bids.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "auction"
            auctions = auctions.append(AuctionInput(fields[1], fields[2:]))
        else
            index := int(#auctions) - 1
            auctions[index].lines = auctions[index].lines.append(BidderLine(fields[1], fields[2], fields[3:]))
    Group[] groups := []
    for row := input_lines("single_item.txt")[]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "lot" or fields[0] == "slots"
            groups = groups.append(Group(fields[0], fields[1], fields[2:]))
        else
            index := int(#groups) - 1
            groups[index].participants = groups[index].participants.append(Participant(fields[1], int(fields[2]), int(fields[3])))
    settings := input_lines("params.txt")
    int[] numbers := []
    for: 1 <= i < int(#settings)
        numbers = numbers.append(int(settings[i].split(" ")[1]))
    parameters := Parameters(settings[0].split(" ")[1:], numbers[0], numbers[1], numbers[2], numbers[3], numbers[4], numbers[5], numbers[6], numbers[7], numbers[8])
    return Inputs(items, auctions, groups, parameters)

import bids_io = "./bids_io.qui"
import wdp_solver = "./wdp_solver.qui"
import payments = "./payments.qui"
import auctions = "./auctions.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

class Bidder(string name, string language)
    bids_io.Bid[] valid := []
    eligible := 0
class Rejection(int number, string bidder, string message)
class Auction(string name, int[] offered, nat32 offered_mask, Bidder[] bidders, int total, bids_io.Bid[] valid, bids_io.Bid[] eligible, Rejection[] rejected)
class Allocation(bids_io.Bid[] winning, int accepted, int retained, int welfare, nat32 unsold)
class Ascending()
    string[] lines := []
    int[] paid := []
    int[] values := []
    int[] utilities := []
    revenue := 0
    welfare := 0
    retained := 0
    rounds := 0
    capped := false
    exposed := 0
    exposure := 0

class AuctionResult(Auction auction, wdp_solver.Search search, Allocation optimal, bids_io.Bid[] order, Allocation greedy, payments.Critical[] critical, int[] values, payments.Vcg[] vcg, int[] greedy_values, int[] critical_paid, int[] vcg_utilities, int[] critical_utilities, Ascending ascending)
class Mechanism(string name, int winner, int price, int revenue, int welfare, int[] utilities, steps := -1)
class Totals()
    bids := 0
    valid := 0
    eligible := 0
    nodes := 0
    greedy_optimal := 0
    revenues := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    checked := 0
    skipped := 0
    core := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    rounds := 0
    capped := 0
    exposed := 0
    exposure := 0
    lots := 0
    slots := 0
    errors := 0
    envy_free := 0
    nash := 0
    equilibria := 0
class Reports()
    string[] wdp := []
    string[] vcg := []
    string[] core := []
    string[] ascending := []
    string[] single := []
    summary := ["mechanism,revenue,welfare,efficiency"]
    totals := Totals()

int item_index(bids_io.Item[] items, string name)
    for: i < int(#items)
        if items[i].name == name
            return i
    return -1

bool lowercase_word(string text)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for code := text.codepoints()[]
        if code < 97 or code > 122
            return false
    return true

bool decimal_digits(string text)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for code := text.codepoints()[]
        if code < 48 or code > 57
            return false
    return true

Auction validate_auction(bids_io.AuctionInput input, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Parameters settings)
    int[] offered := []
    nat32 offered_mask := 0
    for name := input.offered[]
        index := item_index(items, name)
        offered = offered.append(index)
        offered_mask = offered_mask OR report.bit_for(index)
    Bidder[] bidders := []
    bids_io.Bid[] valid := []
    bids_io.Bid[] eligible := []
    Rejection[] rejected := []
    distinct<string> seen
    number := 0
    for line := input.lines[]
        line_error := ""
        if seen.has(line.name)
            line_error = "duplicate bidder"
        elif line.language != "XOR" and line.language != "OR"
            line_error = "bad language " + line.language
        .seen.add(line.name)
        bidder := -1
        if line_error == ""
            bidder = int(#bidders)
            bidders = bidders.append(Bidder(line.name, line.language))
        map<nat32, int> earlier_bundles
        for text := line.bids[]
            number += 1
            problem := line_error
            nat32 bundle := 0
            amount := 0
            reserve := 0
            size := 0
            if problem == ""
                string[] parts := text.split(":")
                malformed := #parts != 2
                string[] names := []
                if not malformed
                    names = parts[0].split("+")
                    for name := names[]
                        malformed = malformed or not lowercase_word(name)
                    price_text := parts[1]
                    malformed = malformed or not decimal_digits(price_text) or #price_text > 5 or (#price_text > 1 and price_text[0] == "0")
                if malformed
                    problem = "malformed bid"
                else
                    amount = int(parts[1])
                    size = int(#names)
                    for name := names[]
                        index := item_index(items, name)
                        if index < 0
                            problem = "unknown item " + name
                            break
                        if not report.contains_item(offered_mask, index)
                            problem = "item not offered " + name
                            break
                        if report.contains_item(bundle, index)
                            problem = "duplicate item " + name
                            break
                        bundle = bundle OR report.bit_for(index)
                        reserve += items[index].reserve
                    if problem == "" and size > settings.max_bundle_size
                        problem = "bundle too large"
                    if problem == "" and amount == 0
                        problem = "zero value"
                    if problem == ""
                        match earlier_bundles.get(bundle)
                            int previous
                                problem = "duplicate bundle {previous}"
                            none
                                void
                    if problem == "" and int(#bidders[bidder].valid) >= settings.max_bids
                        problem = "too many bids"
            if problem != ""
                rejected = rejected.append(Rejection(number, line.name, problem))
                continue
            bid := bids_io.Bid(number, bidder, bundle, amount, line.language == "XOR", size, reserve)
            valid = valid.append(bid)
            bidders[bidder].valid = bidders[bidder].valid.append(bid)
            .earlier_bundles.set(bundle, number)
            if amount >= reserve
                eligible = eligible.append(bid)
                bidders[bidder].eligible += 1
    return Auction(input.name, offered, offered_mask, bidders, number, valid, eligible, rejected)

Allocation allocation_values(Auction auction, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Bid[] chosen)
    winning := wdp_solver.bid_number_order(chosen)
    accepted := 0
    nat32 sold := 0
    for bid := winning[]
        accepted += bid.amount
        sold = sold OR bid.bundle
    unsold := auction.offered_mask AND NOT sold
    retained := 0
    for item := auction.offered[]
        if report.contains_item(unsold, item)
            retained += items[item].reserve
    return Allocation(winning, accepted, retained, accepted + retained, unsold)

string unsold_names(nat32 mask, bids_io.Item[] items)
    string[] names := []
    for: i < int(#items)
        if report.contains_item(mask, i)
            names = names.append(items[i].name)
    return if #names == 0 then "-" else names.join(" ")

Ascending simulate_ascending(Auction auction, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Parameters settings, int optimum)
    result := Ascending()
    result.lines = ["AUCTION {auction.name} increment {settings.saa_increment}"]
    auctions.Candidate[][] candidates := []
    int[] eligibility := []
    for bidder := auction.bidders[]
        auctions.Candidate[] choices := auctions.enumerate_candidates(bidder.valid, bidder.language == "XOR")
        candidates = candidates.append(choices)
        maximum := 0
        for candidate := choices[]
            size := report.mask_size(candidate.bundle)
            if size > maximum
                maximum = size
        eligibility = eligibility.append(maximum)
    prices := [for item := items[] then item.reserve]
    holders := array(#items, fill = -1)
    bid_counts := array(#items, fill = 0)
    round_counts := array(#items, fill = 0)
    last_rounds := array(#items, fill = 0)
    random_state := settings.seed
    for: 1 <= round <= settings.round_cap
        result.rounds = round
        nat32[] new_bids := []
        int[] activity := []
        demand := 0
        for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
            nat32 held := 0
            for item := auction.offered[]
                if holders[item] == bidder
                    held = held OR report.bit_for(item)
            chosen := -1
            best_surplus := 0
            for: i < int(#candidates[bidder])
                candidate := candidates[bidder][i]
                if report.mask_size(candidate.bundle OR held) > eligibility[bidder]
                    continue
                asking_total := 0
                for item := auction.offered[]
                    if report.contains_item(candidate.bundle, item)
                        asking_total += prices[item] + (if holders[item] >= 0 and holders[item] != bidder then settings.saa_increment else 0)
                surplus := candidate.value - asking_total
                if surplus > best_surplus
                    best_surplus = surplus
                    chosen = i
            nat32 bids := 0
            active := held
            if chosen >= 0
                wanted := candidates[bidder][chosen].bundle
                active = active OR wanted
                for item := auction.offered[]
                    if report.contains_item(wanted, item) and holders[item] != bidder
                        bids = bids OR report.bit_for(item)
            activity = activity.append(report.mask_size(active))
            new_bids = new_bids.append(bids)
            demand += report.mask_size(bids)
        if demand == 0
            result.lines = result.lines.append("ROUND {round} none")
        else
            line := "ROUND {round} demand {demand}"
            for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
                if new_bids[bidder] != 0
                    line += " {auction.bidders[bidder].name}:" + report.bundle_text(new_bids[bidder], items)
            result.lines = result.lines.append(line)
            for item := auction.offered[]
                int[] entrants := []
                for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
                    if report.contains_item(new_bids[bidder], item)
                        entrants = entrants.append(bidder)
                count := int(#entrants)
                if count == 0
                    continue
                bid_counts[item] += count
                round_counts[item] += 1
                last_rounds[item] = round
                selected := 0
                if count >= 2
                    random_state = 48271 * random_state % 2147483647
                    selected = random_state % count
                if holders[item] >= 0
                    prices[item] += settings.saa_increment
                holders[item] = entrants[selected]
            standing := "STANDING"
            for item := auction.offered[]
                holder := if holders[item] < 0 then "-" else auction.bidders[holders[item]].name
                standing += " {items[item].name}={prices[item]}@{holder}"
            result.lines = result.lines.append(standing)
        string[] changed := []
        for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
            if activity[bidder] < eligibility[bidder]
                eligibility[bidder] = activity[bidder]
                changed = changed.append("{auction.bidders[bidder].name}={eligibility[bidder]}")
        if #changed > 0
            result.lines = result.lines.append("ELIGIBILITY " + changed.join(" "))
        if demand == 0
            break
        if round == settings.round_cap
            result.capped = true
    result.lines = result.lines.append("END rounds {result.rounds} " + (if result.capped then "cap" else "quiet"))
    for item := auction.offered[]
        if holders[item] < 0
            result.retained += items[item].reserve
            result.lines = result.lines.append("ITEM {items[item].name} unsold reserve {items[item].reserve}")
        else
            result.lines = result.lines.append("ITEM {items[item].name} price {prices[item]} holder {auction.bidders[holders[item]].name} bids {bid_counts[item]} rounds {round_counts[item]} last {last_rounds[item]}")
    for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
        nat32 won := 0
        paid := 0
        for item := auction.offered[]
            if holders[item] == bidder
                won = won OR report.bit_for(item)
                paid += prices[item]
        value := auctions.value_of(candidates[bidder], won)
        utility := value - paid
        result.paid = result.paid.append(paid)
        result.values = result.values.append(value)
        result.utilities = result.utilities.append(utility)
        result.revenue += paid
        result.welfare += value
        line := "BIDDER {auction.bidders[bidder].name} won " + report.bundle_text(won, items) + " paid {paid} value {value} utility {utility} eligibility {eligibility[bidder]}"
        if utility < 0
            result.exposed += 1
            result.exposure -= utility
            line += " exposed"
        result.lines = result.lines.append(line)
    result.welfare += result.retained
    efficiency := report.Fraction(result.welfare, optimum)
    result.lines = result.lines.append("TOTAL revenue {result.revenue} welfare {result.welfare} efficiency " + efficiency.text() + " exposure {result.exposure} exposed {result.exposed}")
    return result

AuctionResult analyze_auction(Auction auction, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Parameters settings)
    search := wdp_solver.solve_wdp(auction.offered, items, auction.eligible)
    optimal := allocation_values(auction, items, search.winning)
    order := wdp_solver.greedy_order(auction.eligible)
    greedy := allocation_values(auction, items, wdp_solver.greedy_select(order))
    payments.Critical[] critical := payments.critical_payments(order, greedy.winning)
    values := array(#auction.bidders, fill = 0)
    for bid := optimal.winning[]
        values[bid.bidder] += bid.amount
    payments.Vcg[] vcg := payments.vcg_payments(auction.offered, items, auction.eligible, optimal.welfare, values)
    greedy_values := array(#auction.bidders, fill = 0)
    critical_paid := array(#auction.bidders, fill = 0)
    for bid := greedy.winning[]
        greedy_values[bid.bidder] += bid.amount
        for price := critical[]
            if price.number == bid.number
                critical_paid[bid.bidder] += price.payment
    int[] vcg_utilities := []
    int[] critical_utilities := []
    for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
        vcg_utilities = vcg_utilities.append(values[bidder] - vcg[bidder].payment)
        critical_utilities = critical_utilities.append(greedy_values[bidder] - critical_paid[bidder])
    ascending := simulate_ascending(auction, items, settings, optimal.welfare)
    return AuctionResult(auction, search, optimal, order, greedy, critical, values, vcg, greedy_values, critical_paid, vcg_utilities, critical_utilities, ascending)

void append_summary(Reports &reports, string name, string format, report.Fraction revenue, report.Fraction welfare, report.Fraction efficiency)
    reports.summary = reports.summary.append(name + "/" + format + "," + revenue.text() + "," + welfare.text() + "," + efficiency.text())

void append_wdp(Reports &reports, AuctionResult result, bids_io.Item[] items)
    auction := result.auction
    lines := ["AUCTION {auction.name} items {#auction.offered} bidders {#auction.bidders} bids {auction.total} valid {#auction.valid} eligible {#auction.eligible}"]
    for bidder := auction.bidders[]
        lines = lines.append("BIDDER {bidder.name} {bidder.language} valid {#bidder.valid} eligible {bidder.eligible}")
    for rejected := auction.rejected[]
        lines = lines.append("REJECT {rejected.number} {rejected.bidder} {rejected.message}")
    for bid := auction.valid[]
        if bid.amount < bid.reserve
            lines = lines.append("BELOW_RESERVE {bid.number} {auction.bidders[bid.bidder].name} value {bid.amount} reserve {bid.reserve}")
    for share := result.search.shares[]
        source := if share.source < 0 then "reserve" else "bid {share.source}"
        lines = lines.append("SHARE {items[share.item].name} " + share.amount.text() + " " + source)
    lines = lines.append("ROOT_BOUND " + result.search.bound.text())
    for improvement := result.search.improvements[]
        lines = lines.append("IMPROVE {improvement.node} welfare {improvement.welfare} bids " + report.number_list(improvement.numbers))
    optimal := result.optimal
    lines = lines.append("OPTIMAL welfare {optimal.welfare} accepted {optimal.accepted} retained {optimal.retained} winners {#optimal.winning}")
    for bid := optimal.winning[]
        lines = lines.append("WIN {bid.number} {auction.bidders[bid.bidder].name} " + report.bundle_text(bid.bundle, items) + " {bid.amount}")
    lines = lines.concat(["UNSOLD " + unsold_names(optimal.unsold, items), "SEARCH nodes {result.search.nodes} pruned {result.search.pruned} leaves {result.search.leaves} improvements {#result.search.improvements}"])
    order := if #result.order == 0 then "-" else [for bid := result.order[] then string(bid.number)].join(" ")
    lines = lines.append("GREEDY_ORDER " + order)
    greedy := result.greedy
    efficiency := report.Fraction(greedy.welfare, optimal.welfare)
    lines = lines.append("GREEDY welfare {greedy.welfare} accepted {greedy.accepted} retained {greedy.retained} winners {#greedy.winning} efficiency " + efficiency.text())
    for: i < int(#greedy.winning)
        bid := greedy.winning[i]
        price := result.critical[i]
        rival := if price.rival < 0 then "-" else string(price.rival)
        lines = lines.append("GWIN {bid.number} {auction.bidders[bid.bidder].name} " + report.bundle_text(bid.bundle, items) + " {bid.amount} critical {price.payment} against {rival}")
    lines = lines.append("GUNSOLD " + unsold_names(greedy.unsold, items))
    for item := auction.offered[]
        demand := 0
        optimal_owner := "-"
        greedy_owner := "-"
        for bid := auction.eligible[]
            if report.contains_item(bid.bundle, item)
                demand += 1
        for bid := optimal.winning[]
            if report.contains_item(bid.bundle, item)
                optimal_owner = auction.bidders[bid.bidder].name
        for bid := greedy.winning[]
            if report.contains_item(bid.bundle, item)
                greedy_owner = auction.bidders[bid.bidder].name
        lines = lines.append("ITEM {items[item].name} reserve {items[item].reserve} demand {demand} optimal {optimal_owner} greedy {greedy_owner}")
    reports.wdp = reports.wdp.concat(lines)
    reports.totals.bids += auction.total
    reports.totals.valid += int(#auction.valid)
    reports.totals.eligible += int(#auction.eligible)
    reports.totals.nodes += result.search.nodes
    if greedy.welfare == optimal.welfare
        reports.totals.greedy_optimal += 1

void append_vcg(Reports &reports, AuctionResult result)
    auction := result.auction
    lines := ["AUCTION {auction.name} welfare {result.optimal.welfare}"]
    revenue := 0
    utilities := 0
    critical_total := 0
    for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
        name := auction.bidders[bidder].name
        if result.values[bidder] == 0
            lines = lines.append("BIDDER {name} lost")
        else
            won := [for bid := result.optimal.winning[] if bid.bidder == bidder then bid.number]
            payment := result.vcg[bidder]
            lines = lines.append("BIDDER {name} won " + report.number_list(won) + " value {result.values[bidder]} without {payment.without} alternative " + report.number_list(payment.alternative) + " payment {payment.payment} utility {result.vcg_utilities[bidder]}")
        revenue += result.vcg[bidder].payment
        utilities += result.vcg_utilities[bidder]
        critical_total += result.critical_paid[bidder]
    lines = lines.append("TOTAL revenue {revenue} pay_as_bid {result.optimal.accepted} retained {result.optimal.retained} seller {revenue + result.optimal.retained} bidders {utilities}")
    for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
        lines = lines.append("PAYMENTS {auction.bidders[bidder].name} vcg {result.vcg[bidder].payment} pay_as_bid {result.values[bidder]} greedy {result.greedy_values[bidder]} critical {result.critical_paid[bidder]} saa {result.ascending.paid[bidder]}")
    for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
        lines = lines.append("UTILITIES {auction.bidders[bidder].name} vcg {result.vcg_utilities[bidder]} critical {result.critical_utilities[bidder]} saa {result.ascending.utilities[bidder]}")
    reports.vcg = reports.vcg.concat(lines)
    revenues := [revenue, result.optimal.accepted, result.greedy.accepted, critical_total, result.ascending.revenue]
    welfares := [result.optimal.welfare, result.optimal.welfare, result.greedy.welfare, result.greedy.welfare, result.ascending.welfare]
    formats := ["vcg", "pay_as_bid", "greedy", "critical", "saa"]
    for: i < 5
        reports.totals.revenues[i] += revenues[i]
        append_summary(&reports, auction.name, formats[i], report.Fraction(revenues[i]), report.Fraction(welfares[i]), report.Fraction(welfares[i], result.optimal.welfare))

string coalition_name(payments.Coalition coalition, Bidder[] bidders)
    return if #coalition.members == 0 then "-" else [for bidder := coalition.members[] then bidders[bidder].name].join("+")

void append_core(Reports &reports, AuctionResult result, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Parameters settings)
    auction := result.auction
    lines := ["AUCTION {auction.name} bidders {#auction.bidders}"]
    if int(#auction.bidders) > settings.core_max
        reports.totals.skipped += 1
        reports.core = reports.core.concat(lines).append("SKIPPED")
        return
    reports.totals.checked += 1
    payments.Coalition[] coalitions := payments.coalition_welfares(auction.offered, items, auction.eligible, int(#auction.bidders))
    lines = lines.append("COALITIONS {#coalitions}")
    vcg_revenue := 0
    critical_revenue := 0
    for: bidder < int(#auction.bidders)
        vcg_revenue += result.vcg[bidder].payment
        critical_revenue += result.critical_paid[bidder]
    names := ["vcg", "greedy", "critical", "saa"]
    sellers := [vcg_revenue + result.optimal.retained, result.greedy.welfare, critical_revenue + result.greedy.retained, result.ascending.revenue + result.ascending.retained]
    zero := array(#auction.bidders, fill = 0)
    utilities := [result.vcg_utilities, zero, result.critical_utilities, result.ascending.utilities]
    for: outcome < 4
        lines = lines.append("OUTCOME {names[outcome]} seller {sellers[outcome]} utilities " + [for utility := utilities[outcome][] then string(utility)].join(" "))
        blocking := payments.blocking_coalitions(coalitions, sellers[outcome], utilities[outcome])
        for block := blocking.minimal[]
            lines = lines.append("BLOCK " + coalition_name(block.coalition, auction.bidders) + " welfare {block.coalition.welfare} payoff {block.payoff} deficit {block.deficit} bids " + report.number_list(block.coalition.numbers))
        if #blocking.all == 0
            reports.totals.core[outcome] += 1
            lines = lines.append("RESULT core")
        else
            maximum := 0
            for: i < int(#blocking.all)
                if blocking.all[i].deficit > blocking.all[maximum].deficit
                    maximum = i
            lines = lines.append("RESULT blocked {#blocking.all} minimal {#blocking.minimal} max_deficit {blocking.all[maximum].deficit} by " + coalition_name(blocking.all[maximum].coalition, auction.bidders))
    reports.core = reports.core.concat(lines)

string participants_error(bids_io.Participant[] participants, string kind)
    if #participants == 0
        return if kind == "lot" then "no bidders" else "no advertisers"
    distinct<string> seen
    for participant := participants[]
        if seen.has(participant.name)
            return (if kind == "lot" then "duplicate bidder " else "duplicate advertiser ") + participant.name
        .seen.add(participant.name)
    if kind == "lot"
        for participant := participants[]
            if participant.bid > participant.value
                return "bid above value " + participant.name
    return ""

int[] participant_ranking(bids_io.Participant[] participants, bool by_value)
    int[] result := []
    for: i < int(#participants)
        result = result.append(i)
        position := i
        while position > 0
            a := result[position]
            b := result[position - 1]
            first := if by_value then participants[a].value else participants[a].bid
            second := if by_value then participants[b].value else participants[b].bid
            if first <= second
                break
            result[position] = b
            result[position - 1] = a
            position -= 1
    return result

Mechanism mechanism_result(string name, int winner, int price, int reserve, bids_io.Participant[] participants, steps := -1)
    utilities := array(#participants, fill = 0)
    revenue := price
    welfare := reserve
    if winner >= 0
        welfare = participants[winner].value
        utilities[winner] = welfare - price
    if name == "all_pay"
        revenue = 0
        for: i < int(#participants)
            if participants[i].bid >= reserve
                revenue += participants[i].bid
                utilities[i] = (if i == winner then participants[i].value else 0) - participants[i].bid
    return Mechanism(name, winner, price, revenue, welfare, utilities, steps)

void process_lot(Reports &reports, bids_io.Group group, bids_io.Parameters settings)
    reports.totals.lots += 1
    bids_io.Participant[] participants := group.participants
    problem := participants_error(participants, "lot")
    if problem != ""
        reports.totals.errors += 1
        reports.single = reports.single.append("LOT {group.name} ERROR {problem}")
        return
    reserve := int(group.arguments[0])
    bid_order := participant_ranking(participants, false)
    value_order := participant_ranking(participants, true)
    efficient := if participants[value_order[0]].value >= reserve then value_order[0] else -1
    optimum := if efficient < 0 then reserve else participants[efficient].value
    first_winner := if participants[bid_order[0]].bid >= reserve then bid_order[0] else -1
    first_price := if first_winner < 0 then 0 else participants[first_winner].bid
    second_price := 0
    if efficient >= 0
        second_price = reserve
        if #value_order > 1 and participants[value_order[1]].value > second_price
            second_price = participants[value_order[1]].value
    english := auctions.english_clock(participants, reserve, settings.english_increment)
    dutch := auctions.dutch_clock(participants, reserve, settings.dutch_start, settings.dutch_decrement)
    mechanisms := [
        mechanism_result("first_price", first_winner, first_price, reserve, participants),
        mechanism_result("second_price", efficient, second_price, reserve, participants),
        mechanism_result("english", english.winner, english.price, reserve, participants, english.steps),
        mechanism_result("dutch", dutch.winner, dutch.price, reserve, participants, dutch.steps),
        mechanism_result("all_pay", first_winner, first_price, reserve, participants),
    ]
    efficient_name := if efficient < 0 then "-" else participants[efficient].name
    lines := ["LOT {group.name} reserve {reserve} bidders {#participants} efficient {efficient_name} optimum {optimum}"]
    labels := ["FIRST_PRICE", "SECOND_PRICE", "ENGLISH", "DUTCH", "ALL_PAY"]
    for: i < 5
        mechanism := mechanisms[i]
        line := labels[i]
        if mechanism.winner < 0
            line += " unsold"
        else
            winner := mechanism.winner
            line += " winner {participants[winner].name} price {mechanism.price} utility {mechanism.utilities[winner]}"
        if mechanism.steps >= 0
            line += " steps {mechanism.steps}"
        efficiency := report.Fraction(mechanism.welfare, optimum)
        lines = lines.append(line + " revenue {mechanism.revenue} welfare {mechanism.welfare} efficiency " + efficiency.text())
        if i == 2
            drops := "ENGLISH_DROPS"
            for: j < int(#participants)
                value := if english.drops[j] < 0 then "-" else string(english.drops[j])
                drops += " {participants[j].name}={value}"
            lines = lines.append(drops)
        append_summary(&reports, group.name, mechanism.name, report.Fraction(mechanism.revenue), report.Fraction(mechanism.welfare), efficiency)
    for: bidder < int(#participants)
        line := "UTILITY {participants[bidder].name}"
        for mechanism := mechanisms[]
            line += " {mechanism.utilities[bidder]}"
        lines = lines.append(line)
    ranking := [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    for: 1 <= i < 5
        j := i
        while j > 0 and mechanisms[ranking[j]].revenue > mechanisms[ranking[j - 1]].revenue
            temporary := ranking[j - 1]
            ranking[j - 1] = ranking[j]
            ranking[j] = temporary
            j -= 1
    lines = lines.append("RANKING " + [for index := ranking[] then mechanisms[index].name].join(" "))
    reports.single = reports.single.concat(lines)

class Rates(bool valid, string bad, report.Fraction[] values)

Rates parse_rates(string[] texts)
    report.Fraction[] rates := []
    for text := texts[]
        parts := text.split("/")
        malformed := #parts != 2
        if not malformed
            malformed = not decimal_digits(parts[0]) or not decimal_digits(parts[1]) or parts[0][0] == "0" or parts[1][0] == "0"
        if malformed
            return Rates(false, text, [])
        rate := report.Fraction(int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]))
        if report.Fraction(1).less(rate) or (#rates > 0 and not rate.less(rates[-1]))
            return Rates(false, text, [])
        rates = rates.append(rate)
    return Rates(true, "", rates)

report.Fraction rate_at(report.Fraction[] rates, int rank)
    return if rank < int(#rates) then rates[rank] else report.Fraction(0)

int bid_at(bids_io.Participant[] participants, int[] ranking, int rank)
    return if rank < int(#ranking) then participants[ranking[rank]].bid else 0

void process_slots(Reports &reports, bids_io.Group group)
    reports.totals.slots += 1
    parsed := parse_rates(group.arguments)
    problem := if parsed.valid then participants_error(group.participants, "slots") else "bad ctr " + parsed.bad
    if problem != ""
        reports.totals.errors += 1
        reports.single = reports.single.append("SLOTS {group.name} ERROR {problem}")
        return
    rates := parsed.values
    bids_io.Participant[] participants := group.participants
    ranking := participant_ranking(participants, false)
    efficient := participant_ranking(participants, true)
    slots := int(#rates)
    count := int(#participants)
    assigned := if count < slots then count else slots
    lines := ["SLOTS {group.name} slots {slots} advertisers {count}"]
    gsp_revenue := report.Fraction(0)
    gsp_welfare := report.Fraction(0)
    optimum := report.Fraction(0)
    for: rank < assigned
        optimum = optimum.add(rates[rank].times(participants[efficient[rank]].value))
    for: rank < assigned
        participant := participants[ranking[rank]]
        price := payments.gsp_price(participants, ranking, rank)
        payment := rates[rank].times(price)
        utility := rates[rank].times(participant.value - price)
        gsp_revenue = gsp_revenue.add(payment)
        gsp_welfare = gsp_welfare.add(rates[rank].times(participant.value))
        lines = lines.append("GSP {rank + 1} {participant.name} ctr " + rates[rank].text() + " bid {participant.bid} price {price} payment " + payment.text() + " utility " + utility.text())
    efficiency := gsp_welfare.divided(optimum)
    lines = lines.append("GSP_TOTAL revenue " + gsp_revenue.text() + " welfare " + gsp_welfare.text() + " efficiency " + efficiency.text())
    vcg_revenue := report.Fraction(0)
    for: rank < assigned
        participant := participants[efficient[rank]]
        payment := payments.slot_vcg_payment(participants, efficient, rates, rank)
        price := payment.divided(rates[rank])
        utility := rates[rank].times(participant.value).subtract(payment)
        vcg_revenue = vcg_revenue.add(payment)
        lines = lines.append("VCG {rank + 1} {participant.name} ctr " + rates[rank].text() + " value {participant.value} payment " + payment.text() + " price " + price.text() + " utility " + utility.text())
    lines = lines.append("VCG_TOTAL revenue " + vcg_revenue.text() + " welfare " + optimum.text() + " efficiency 1")
    violations := 0
    envy_stop := if count < slots + 1 then count else slots + 1
    for: 1 <= rank < envy_stop
        participant := participants[ranking[rank]]
        stay := rate_at(rates, rank).times(participant.value - payments.gsp_price(participants, ranking, rank))
        swap := rates[rank - 1].times(participant.value - participant.bid)
        violated := stay.less(swap)
        if violated
            violations += 1
        lines = lines.append("ENVY {rank + 1} {participant.name} stay " + stay.text() + " swap " + swap.text() + " " + (if violated then "violated" else "ok"))
    lines = lines.append(if violations == 0 then "ENVY_FREE yes" else "ENVY_FREE no violations {violations}")
    deviations := 0
    for: rank < count
        participant := participants[ranking[rank]]
        current := rate_at(rates, rank).times(participant.value - payments.gsp_price(participants, ranking, rank))
        for: target < slots
            if target == rank
                continue
            price := bid_at(participants, ranking, if target < rank then target else target + 1)
            moved := rates[target].times(participant.value - price)
            if current.less(moved)
                deviations += 1
                gain := moved.subtract(current)
                lines = lines.append("DEVIATE {participant.name} from {rank + 1} to {target + 1} gain " + gain.text())
    lines = lines.append(if deviations == 0 then "NASH yes" else "NASH no deviations {deviations}")
    equilibrium := violations == 0 and deviations == 0
    lines = lines.append("EQUILIBRIUM " + (if equilibrium then "yes" else "no"))
    if violations == 0
        reports.totals.envy_free += 1
    if deviations == 0
        reports.totals.nash += 1
    if equilibrium
        reports.totals.equilibria += 1
    reports.single = reports.single.concat(lines)
    append_summary(&reports, group.name, "gsp", gsp_revenue, gsp_welfare, efficiency)
    append_summary(&reports, group.name, "vcg", vcg_revenue, optimum, report.Fraction(1))

void finish_reports(Reports &reports, int count)
    Totals totals := reports.totals
    reports.wdp = reports.wdp.append("TOTAL auctions {count} bids {totals.bids} valid {totals.valid} eligible {totals.eligible} nodes {totals.nodes} greedy_optimal {totals.greedy_optimal}")
    reports.vcg = reports.vcg.append("OVERALL vcg {totals.revenues[0]} pay_as_bid {totals.revenues[1]} greedy {totals.revenues[2]} critical {totals.revenues[3]} saa {totals.revenues[4]}")
    reports.core = reports.core.append("SUMMARY checked {totals.checked} skipped {totals.skipped} vcg {totals.core[0]} greedy {totals.core[1]} critical {totals.core[2]} saa {totals.core[3]}")
    reports.ascending = reports.ascending.append("SUMMARY auctions {count} rounds {totals.rounds} capped {totals.capped} exposed {totals.exposed} exposure {totals.exposure}")
    reports.single = reports.single.append("SUMMARY lots {totals.lots} slot_groups {totals.slots} errors {totals.errors} envy_free {totals.envy_free} nash {totals.nash} equilibria {totals.equilibria}")

void run_program()
    inputs := bids_io.read_inputs()
    reports := Reports()
    for name := inputs.parameters.runs[]
        selected := 0
        for: i < int(#inputs.auctions)
            if inputs.auctions[i].name == name
                selected = i
        auction := validate_auction(inputs.auctions[selected], inputs.items, inputs.parameters)
        result := analyze_auction(auction, inputs.items, inputs.parameters)
        append_wdp(&reports, result, inputs.items)
        append_vcg(&reports, result)
        append_core(&reports, result, inputs.items, inputs.parameters)
        reports.ascending = reports.ascending.concat(result.ascending.lines)
        reports.totals.rounds += result.ascending.rounds
        if result.ascending.capped
            reports.totals.capped += 1
        reports.totals.exposed += result.ascending.exposed
        reports.totals.exposure += result.ascending.exposure
    for group := inputs.groups[]
        if group.kind == "lot"
            process_lot(&reports, group, inputs.parameters)
        else
            process_slots(&reports, group)
    finish_reports(&reports, int(#inputs.parameters.runs))
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    report.write_lines("wdp.txt", reports.wdp)
    report.write_lines("vcg.txt", reports.vcg)
    report.write_lines("core_check.txt", reports.core)
    report.write_lines("ascending_log.txt", reports.ascending)
    report.write_lines("single_item.txt", reports.single)
    report.write_lines("summary.csv", reports.summary)

run_program()

import bids_io = "./bids_io.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"
import wdp_solver = "./wdp_solver.qui"

class Vcg(int payment, int without, int[] alternative)
class Critical(int number, int payment, int rival)
class Coalition(int[] members, nat32 mask, int welfare, int[] numbers)
class Block(Coalition coalition, int payoff, int deficit)
class Blocking(Block[] all, Block[] minimal)

Vcg[] vcg_payments(int[] offered, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Bid[] bids, int optimal_welfare, int[] values)
    Vcg[] result := []
    for: bidder < int(#values)
        if values[bidder] == 0
            result = result.append(Vcg(0, 0, []))
            continue
        remaining := [for bid := bids[] if bid.bidder != bidder then bid]
        alternative := wdp_solver.solve_wdp(offered, items, remaining)
        result = result.append(Vcg(alternative.welfare - (optimal_welfare - values[bidder]), alternative.welfare, alternative.numbers))
    return result

bool threshold_earlier(int amount, bids_io.Bid bid, bids_io.Bid rival)
    left := amount * amount * rival.size
    right := rival.amount * rival.amount * bid.size
    return left > right or (left == right and bid.number < rival.number)

Critical[] critical_payments(bids_io.Bid[] order, bids_io.Bid[] winning)
    Critical[] result := []
    for bid := winning[]
        remaining := [for other := order[] if other.number != bid.number then other]
        selected := wdp_solver.greedy_select(remaining)
        rival_index := -1
        for: i < int(#selected)
            if (bid.bundle AND selected[i].bundle) != 0 or (bid.xor_bid and bid.bidder == selected[i].bidder)
                rival_index = i
                break
        amount := bid.reserve
        rival_number := -1
        if rival_index >= 0
            rival := selected[rival_index]
            rival_number = rival.number
            low := 1
            high := 1
            while not threshold_earlier(high, bid, rival)
                high *= 2
            while low < high
                middle := (low + high) / 2
                if threshold_earlier(middle, bid, rival)
                    high = middle
                else
                    low = middle + 1
            if low > amount
                amount = low
        result = result.append(Critical(bid.number, amount, rival_number))
    return result

void enumerate_members(int count, int wanted, int start, int[] chosen, int[][] &result)
    if int(#chosen) == wanted
        result = result.append(chosen)
        return
    needed := wanted - int(#chosen)
    for: start <= next <= count - needed
        enumerate_members(count, wanted, next + 1, chosen.append(next), &result)

Coalition[] coalition_welfares(int[] offered, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Bid[] bids, int count)
    int[][] membership := []
    for: size <= count
        enumerate_members(count, size, 0, [], &membership)
    Coalition[] result := []
    for members := membership[]
        nat32 mask := 0
        for bidder := members[]
            mask = mask OR report.bit_for(bidder)
        restricted := [for bid := bids[] if report.contains_item(mask, bid.bidder) then bid]
        allocation := wdp_solver.solve_wdp(offered, items, restricted)
        result = result.append(Coalition(members, mask, allocation.welfare, allocation.numbers))
    return result

Blocking blocking_coalitions(Coalition[] coalitions, int seller, int[] utilities)
    Block[] all := []
    Block[] minimal := []
    for coalition := coalitions[]
        payoff := seller
        for bidder := coalition.members[]
            payoff += utilities[bidder]
        if coalition.welfare <= payoff
            continue
        current := Block(coalition, payoff, coalition.welfare - payoff)
        is_minimal := true
        for earlier := all[]
            if (earlier.coalition.mask AND coalition.mask) == earlier.coalition.mask
                is_minimal = false
        if is_minimal
            minimal = minimal.append(current)
        all = all.append(current)
    return Blocking(all, minimal)

int gsp_price(bids_io.Participant[] participants, int[] ranking, int rank)
    return if rank + 1 < int(#ranking) then participants[ranking[rank + 1]].bid else 0

report.Fraction slot_vcg_payment(bids_io.Participant[] participants, int[] ranking, report.Fraction[] rates, int rank)
    payment := report.Fraction(0)
    stop := if #ranking < #rates + 1 then int(#ranking) else int(#rates) + 1
    for: rank + 1 <= following < stop
        next_rate := if following < int(#rates) then rates[following] else report.Fraction(0)
        payment = payment.add(rates[following - 1].subtract(next_rate).times(participants[ranking[following]].value))
    return payment

import bids_io = "./bids_io.qui"

int greatest_divisor(int first, int second)
    a := if first < 0 then -first else first
    b := if second < 0 then -second else second
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

class Fraction(int numerator, denominator := 1)
    if denominator < 0
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator
    local divisor := greatest_divisor(numerator, denominator)
    numerator /= divisor
    denominator /= divisor

    Fraction add(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Fraction subtract(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator, denominator * other.denominator)

    Fraction times(int amount)
        return Fraction(numerator * amount, denominator)

    Fraction divided(Fraction other)
        return Fraction(numerator * other.denominator, denominator * other.numerator)

    bool less(Fraction other)
        return numerator * other.denominator < other.numerator * denominator

    string text()
        return if denominator == 1 then string(numerator) else "{numerator}/{denominator}"

nat32 bit_for(int position)
    return nat32(1) << nat32(position)

int mask_size(nat32 mask)
    remaining := mask
    count := 0
    while remaining != 0
        remaining = remaining AND (remaining - 1)
        count += 1
    return count

bool contains_item(nat32 mask, int position)
    return (mask AND bit_for(position)) != 0

string bundle_text(nat32 mask, bids_io.Item[] items)
    string[] names := []
    for: i < int(#items)
        if contains_item(mask, i)
            names = names.append(items[i].name)
    return if #names == 0 then "-" else names.join("+")

string number_list(int[] numbers)
    return if #numbers == 0 then "-" else [for number := numbers.sorted()[] then string(number)].join("+")

void write_lines(string filename, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + filename)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

import bids_io = "./bids_io.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

class Share(int item, report.Fraction amount, int source)
class Improvement(int node, int welfare, int[] numbers)
class Search()
    welfare := -1
    int[] numbers := []
    bids_io.Bid[] winning := []
    nodes := 0
    pruned := 0
    leaves := 0
    Improvement[] improvements := []
    Share[] shares := []
    bound := report.Fraction(0)

bool numbers_earlier(int[] first, int[] second)
    common := if #first < #second then int(#first) else int(#second)
    for: i < common
        if first[i] != second[i]
            return first[i] < second[i]
    return #first < #second

Share[] compute_shares(int[] offered, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Bid[] bids, nat32 decided := 0)
    Share[] result := []
    for item := offered[]
        if report.contains_item(decided, item)
            continue
        share := report.Fraction(items[item].reserve)
        source := -1
        for bid := bids[]
            if report.contains_item(bid.bundle, item)
                candidate := report.Fraction(bid.amount, bid.size)
                if share.less(candidate)
                    share = candidate
                    source = bid.number
        result = result.append(Share(item, share, source))
    return result

void visit_node(int[] offered, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Bid[] bids, nat32 decided, nat32 used_xor, int welfare, int[] chosen, Search &result)
    result.nodes += 1
    first := -1
    for item := offered[]
        if not report.contains_item(decided, item)
            first = item
            break
    if first < 0
        result.leaves += 1
        numbers := chosen.sorted()
        if result.welfare < 0 or welfare > result.welfare or (welfare == result.welfare and numbers_earlier(numbers, result.numbers))
            result.welfare = welfare
            result.numbers = numbers
            result.improvements = result.improvements.append(Improvement(result.nodes, welfare, numbers))
        return
    bids_io.Bid[] usable := []
    for bid := bids[]
        if (bid.bundle AND decided) == 0 and (not bid.xor_bid or not report.contains_item(used_xor, bid.bidder))
            usable = usable.append(bid)
    bound := report.Fraction(welfare)
    for share := compute_shares(offered, items, usable, decided)[]
        bound = bound.add(share.amount)
    if result.welfare >= 0 and bound.less(report.Fraction(result.welfare))
        result.pruned += 1
        return
    for bid := usable[]
        if report.contains_item(bid.bundle, first)
            next_used := if bid.xor_bid then used_xor OR report.bit_for(bid.bidder) else used_xor
            visit_node(offered, items, bids, decided OR bid.bundle, next_used, welfare + bid.amount, chosen.append(bid.number), &result)
    visit_node(offered, items, bids, decided OR report.bit_for(first), used_xor, welfare + items[first].reserve, chosen, &result)

bids_io.Bid[] bid_number_order(bids_io.Bid[] bids)
    result := bids
    for: 1 <= i < int(#result)
        j := i
        while j > 0 and result[j].number < result[j - 1].number
            temporary := result[j - 1]
            result[j - 1] = result[j]
            result[j] = temporary
            j -= 1
    return result

Search solve_wdp(int[] offered, bids_io.Item[] items, bids_io.Bid[] bids)
    ordered := bid_number_order(bids)
    result := Search()
    result.shares = compute_shares(offered, items, ordered)
    for share := result.shares[]
        result.bound = result.bound.add(share.amount)
    visit_node(offered, items, ordered, 0, 0, 0, [], &result)
    for bid := ordered[]
        for number := result.numbers[]
            if bid.number == number
                result.winning = result.winning.append(bid)
    return result

bool greedy_before(bids_io.Bid first, bids_io.Bid second)
    left := first.amount * first.amount * second.size
    right := second.amount * second.amount * first.size
    return if left != right then left > right else first.number < second.number

bids_io.Bid[] greedy_order(bids_io.Bid[] bids)
    result := bids
    for: 1 <= i < int(#result)
        j := i
        while j > 0 and greedy_before(result[j], result[j - 1])
            temporary := result[j - 1]
            result[j - 1] = result[j]
            result[j] = temporary
            j -= 1
    return result

bids_io.Bid[] greedy_select(bids_io.Bid[] bids)
    nat32 occupied := 0
    nat32 used_xor := 0
    bids_io.Bid[] chosen := []
    for bid := bids[]
        if (bid.bundle AND occupied) != 0 or (bid.xor_bid and report.contains_item(used_xor, bid.bidder))
            continue
        chosen = chosen.append(bid)
        occupied = occupied OR bid.bundle
        if bid.xor_bid
            used_xor = used_xor OR report.bit_for(bid.bidder)
    return chosen
